_comment: Template for user-supplied synthetic Indian-English assets. One JSON object per line (JSONL). Point quotas.synthetic_english.import_dir at a directory and quotas.synthetic_english.metadata_file at a file using this schema, then run: python -m scripts.prepare_datasets fetch --source synthetic_english. The generator fields are mandatory; never leave them blank.
generator_version: exact version or commit of the generator
reference_speaker_ids: non-identifying reference speaker IDs used for generation
reference_audio: reference recording identifiers whose use is permitted
license: license or terms that cover this generated asset
notes: anything the report should preserve; accent verification is unreviewed unless actually reviewed
